easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.farmer_h: Rich Paddy Farmers pass the equipped Knife to Rice loot.
A mature Mushroom Colony waits for an equipped Knife before harvesting.
Rich Soil: No effect on Sugar Cane
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.tool.not: Durability: Not used by this harvest
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.real_loo: Uses the real crop/block loot table
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.farmer_h: A Fortune Hoe is optional for compatible normal crops and never blocks harvesting.
A Fortune Hoe is optional for Tomato loot and is not damaged by crop harvesting.
A ready Melon requires an Axe. Fortune and Silk Touch are resolved by the real Melon loot table.
A ready Pumpkin requires an Axe and uses the real Pumpkin loot table.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.pa: The machine models lower Rice and the upper panicle as one complete lifecycle.
After harvest, mature lower Rice remains and only the upper portion regrows.
Rich Paddy Farmer applies Rich Soil acceleration to Rice.
Install one Sand block first, then plant one Sugar Cane.
Sugar Cane grows virtually from height 1 to 3 and needs no tool.
At height 3, the upper two Cane are harvested and the base remains.
Sneak-use with an empty hand dismantles Sugar Cane mode.
Dismantling returns the Sand and the currently represented Sugar Cane.
Rich Soil does not accelerate Sugar Cane.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.ha: Knife: special harvests; required for mature Mushroom Colonies and optional for Rice loot.
Hoe: optional Fortune for compatible crop loot; it never blocks normal crop progress.
Axe: required for ready Melon/Pumpkin fruit; Fortune and Silk Touch are respected.
Only successful Melon/Pumpkin harvests consume Axe durability; Rice/Mushroom tools do not.
Equipping a tool only affects compatible crops.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.ri: Rich Farmer — Normal Crops
Accepts the normal crops supported by Easy Villagers.
Rich Soil provides the Rich Farmer growth advantage when the crop supports it.
A Hoe is optional and passes Fortune into compatible crop loot.
Normal crop harvesting does not damage the Hoe.
Rich Farmer — Tomatoes & Rope
Plant Tomato Seeds normally in a Rich Farmer.
Install up to two Rope extensions.
Base, Rope 1 and Rope 2 progress independently.
Rich Soil accelerates supported Tomato growth; a Fortune Hoe is optional.
Removing Rope returns the uppermost installed Rope first.
Rich Farmer — Mushroom Colonies
Red and Brown Mushrooms become their matching Farmer’s Delight Colonies.
A Colony can finish growing without a Knife.
Once mature, harvesting waits until a Knife is equipped.
A successful harvest produces 3 mushrooms and resets the Colony to age 0.
The Knife is not damaged by Colony harvesting.
Rich Farmer — Melon
Melon Seeds grow a virtual stem from age 0 to 7.
Rich Soil accelerates stem growth only.
After age 7, fruit generation runs at normal speed.
Once fruit is ready, an Axe is required to harvest it.
The real Melon block loot table handles Fortune and Silk Touch.
The Axe takes one normal durability event only after a successful harvest.
If all outputs do not fit, the fruit waits and the Axe is not damaged.
Rich Farmer — Pumpkin
Pumpkin Seeds grow a virtual stem from age 0 to 7.
Rich Soil accelerates stem growth only.
After age 7, fruit generation runs at normal speed.
Once fruit is ready, an Axe is required to harvest it.
The real Pumpkin block loot table remains authoritative.
The Axe takes one normal durability event only after a successful harvest.
If all outputs do not fit, the fruit waits and the Axe is not damaged.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.cu: Requires one Easy Villagers Villager and provides 4 input plus 4 output slots.
Its protected Cutting Tool slot accepts Knives and Axes.
Farmer’s Delight Cutting recipes have priority over Axe fallback actions.
Axe fallback supports stripping, scraping and wax removal.
Processing is serial: one input completes every 10 ticks.
The complete output must fit before input is consumed or the tool is damaged.
The Cutter is also a workstation for Farmer’s Delight Cutting recipes.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.no: Insert one Easy Villagers Villager; the block has no GUI.
Right-click toggles villager vocalizations for your client only.
The preference persists across dimensions, worlds, servers and restarts.
Muted: Lever ON and Redstone visually powered. Enabled: both visually OFF.
Every loaded switch reflects your same local preference; other players can see another state.
The visual toggle emits no real Redstone and observers cannot detect it.
Without a stored Villager, right-click reports that a villager is required.
jade.easyfarmersdelightcompat.wrong_tool: Wrong tool: Knife or Axe required
